text.body: nārāyaṇottaratāpinīyopaniṣat prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān saccidānandasvarūpo bhavati | dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte | tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti || yo vedādau svaraḥ prokto vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ paraḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyānātmā guhāyāṃ nihito'sya jantoḥ | tamakratuṃ paśyati vītaśoko dhātuḥ prasādānmahimānamīśam || vāsanādvāsudevasya vāsitaṃ hi jagattrayam | sarvabhūtanivāso'si vāsudeva namo'stu te || bhūśca nārāyaṇaḥ | bhuvaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | suvaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | mahaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | janaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | tapaśca nārāyaṇaḥ | satyaṃ ca nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma | nārāyaṇa evedaṃ sarvam | nārāyaṇānna kiñcidasti | satya jñānamanantaṃ brahma | yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyoman | tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ | ākāśādvāyuḥ | vāyoragniḥ | agnerāpaḥ | adbhyaḥ pṛthivī | pṛthivyā oṣadhayaḥ | oṣadhībhyo'nnam | annātpuruṣaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ sarvapuruṣa evedaṃ parabrahma | nārāyaṇaḥ sarvabhūtāntaryāmyātmā | ātmedaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ | tasmātprakāśātmā || nīvāraśūkavattanvī pītā bhāsvatyaṇūpamā | tasyāḥ śikhāyā madhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ || pāśabaddhaḥ smṛto jīvaḥ pāśamuktaḥ sanātanaḥ | tuṣeṇa baddho vrīhiḥ syāttuṣābhāvena taṇḍulaḥ || parabrahma svayaṃ cātmā sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | nārāyaṇamanādiṃ ca yoganidrāparāyaṇam || jāgratsvapnasuṣuptīṣu sarvakālavyavasthitam | nārāyaṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahādhyānaparāyaṇam | sarvavedāntasaṃlakṣyaṃ tadbrahmetyabhidhīyate || hovāca bhagavān nārāyaṇa evedaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇottaratāpinīye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇaḥ paravastu bhavatīti vijñāyate | saccidānandarūpāya jñānāyāmitatejase | parabrahmasvarūpāya nārāyaṇa namo'stu te || nityaśuddhāya buddhāya nityāyādvaitarūpiṇe | ānandāyātmarūpāya nārāyaṇa namo'stu te || oṃ namo bhagavate śrīmannārāyaṇāya mahāviṣṇave amitabalaparākramāya śaṅkhacakragadādharāya lakṣmīsametāya garuḍavāhanāya daśāvatārāya sarvaduṣṭadaityadānavasaṃharaṇāya śiṣṭapratipālakāya parabrahmarūpāya mahātmane paramapuruṣāya puṇḍarīkākṣāya purāṇapuruṣāya śuddhabuddhāya saccidānandasvarūpāya mahātmane ghṛṇiḥ sūrya āditya oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya sahasrāra huṃ phaṭ svāhā || nārāyaṇāya śāntāya śāśvatāya murāraye | yajñeśvarāya yajñāya śaraṇyāya namo namaḥ || sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā sarvaṃ viśvamidaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ ya evaṃ veda ityupaniṣat || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇottaratāpinīye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahmeti ya evaṃ veda | nārāyaṇātmā vedaṃ sarvaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanavastu pratipādyate | sa nārāyaṇo virāṭpuruṣo bhavati | devānāṃ vāsavo bhavati | indriyāṇāṃ mano bhavati | sarveṣāṃ vastūnāṃ mukhyavastu bhavati | oṃ namo nārāyaṇādanyo mantraḥ nārāyaṇādanyopāstirnāsti | nānyannārāyaṇādupāsitavyam | sarvaṃ nārāyaṇa eva bhavatīti vijñāyate | yo'dhīte nityaṃ sarvān kāmānavāpnoti | sa brahmahatyāyāḥ pūto bhavati | surāpānāt pūto bhavati | svarṇasteyāt pūto bhavati | gurutalpagamanāt pūto bhavati | agamyāgamanāt pūto bhavati | abhakṣyabhakṣāt pūto bhavati | sa upapātakamahāpātakebhyaḥ pūto bhavati | sarvavedamadhīyāno bhavati| sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpnoti| sarvakarmakartā bhavati| catuḥsamudraparyantabhūdānaphalaṃ prāpnoti | dvijottamo bhavati | caturvargaphalaṃ prāpnoti | brahmacārī jñānavān bhavati | gṛhī putrapautramahaiśvaryavān bhavati | sanyāsī mokṣavān bhavati || paṭhanācchravaṇādvā'pi sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || nārāyaṇaprasādena vaikuṇṭhapadamaśnute || iti sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat || vedākṣarāṇi yāvanti paṭhitāni dvijottamaiḥ | tāvanti harināmāni kīrtitāni na saṃśayaḥ || nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa vāsudeva jagadguro | mukundācyuta deveśa mahāviṣṇo namo'stu te || bhūtāni tattvasaṃjñāni kūṭastho'kṣarasaṃjñitaḥ | uttamaścāpi puruṣo nārāyaṇa itīryate || ityātharvaṇarahasye nārāyaṇottaratāpinīye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ | iti nārāyaṇottaratāpinīyopaniṣat samāptā
